props.title: Prairie Hill Flower Co.: wedding and event flowers near Denver.
props.lede: When you walk into a wedding, the flowers set the tone before anyone says a word. Prairie Hill Flower Co. is a great choice if you want yours to make a statement.

headingText.html: Lisa Frahm founded Prairie Hill in Parker, and she was a licensed architect before she became a florist. She designs full-service wedding flowers and tailored flowers for private and corporate events.

props.title: Prairie Hill Flower Co. at a glance

rows.text: They offer full-service wedding flowers and custom flowers for private and corporate events.
They’re based in Parker, and they work across the Front Range, including Denver, Colorado Springs and Larkspur.
Prairie Hill started as a flower farm, and many of the blooms in their designs are still grown on that farm.
Their work has been published in several magazines, and they’ve won “Best of” awards year after year.

props.html: Wedding flowers in Denver and Colorado Springs
Lisa’s background in architecture shows up in the work. She thinks about form, scale and balance, so she can build the custom structures that big pieces like ceremony arches need.
Her style is lush and garden-inspired, with airy movement and layered textures, and it ranges from romantic blooms to modern, artful statements.

Their weddings include The Broadmoor in Colorado Springs and Crooked Willow Farm in Larkspur, and their event work includes the Denver Center for the Performing Arts, Cherry Hills Country Club and Villa Parker.

Flowers for private and corporate events

If you’re planning a company party, a gala or a dinner at home, Prairie Hill designs event flowers, too. Their past events include black-tie events, corporate retreats, executive holiday events and parties in private homes.
For a wedding, Lisa starts with a one-on-one consultation, then sends a custom proposal that lists every floral piece, along with a visual plan and color palette.
You can see more of their work on their weddings page and their events page. To check your date, send Prairie Hill an inquiry through their website.
